answer: A payout is split which means 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The pearl schedule is applied in plume and lantern reveals each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2697 identities would post 4866 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
